scientific_integrity: The limiting theorem has an explicit blocking proof with finite covariance formulas; exhaustive finite arithmetic checks support rather than replace this proof. Unread source is treated as a residual risk. The assessment is a self-review, not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Independent Bernoulli static scatterers, all-positive initial spins, fixed density in (0,1/2), integer times O(log N), finitely many fixed offsets only. The simultaneous Gaussian limit is proved; no claim of mixing, universal full-sequence phase law, or global historical priority. The 2004 Kac-ring thesis full text was inaccessible for comparison.
title: Logarithmic fluctuation-scale crossover and lattice-phase memory in the Kac ring
